info.title: ZipLink API
info.description: Cookie sessions, synchronizer-token CSRF, owner-only link management and eventually consistent analytics. Use the same cookie jar for /api/auth/me and subsequent calls. Production uses Secure __Host-ziplink.sid; development uses ziplink.sid. Unexpected origins are rejected. All writes require X-CSRF-Token. Redis failures fail closed for management, fail open for public redirect rate limiting.

get.summary: Resolve public link without a session
get.description: GET records an asynchronous click attempt. HEAD redirects without recording a click. 6000 requests/minute/IP; fails open if Redis rate service is unavailable. Cache-aside with MySQL fallback. Disabled, expired, deleted and unsafe legacy links return 410; never-created links return 404. Queue failure does not prevent a redirect. No destination is fetched by this server.
